displayDescription: Plastic bricks snap onto an empty stud grid: three piers, then an interlocking two-course bridge — an idea becomes a connected system.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.187.0 (WebGLRenderer, InstancedMesh studs, MeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat, PCF soft shadows)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.1 — one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Blender was not used (explicit user instruction); the brick scene is a procedural Three.js approximation rendered in the browser.
Bricks are bevel-free boxes with cylindrical studs; real moulded edge radii, underside tubes and logo-embossed studs are omitted.
Plastic reflection uses a procedurally generated studio environment (PMREM of simple emissive panels), not a measured HDR.
Seating is an animated drop with a small squash; no physical clutch-force simulation.
